title: RDS and DynamoDB
description: Use AWS RDS and DynamoDB with C# in ASP.NET Core applications.
longDescription: Most ASP.NET Core apps need a database. This module teaches how to create RDS instances, connect from C#, use DynamoDB for NoSQL, and choose between relational and NoSQL storage on AWS.
whatYouLearn: Provision RDS instances from C# and the AWS console
Connect to RDS from ASP.NET Core with secrets
Use DynamoDB for NoSQL document storage
Choose between RDS and DynamoDB for different data needs
